name: assembly-newsh4-124
summary: Bronze stag-beetle boss, 120 x 112 px from twenty 2x2 pieces, symmetric about column 60: a central tower (grey steel dome with a tan brim and crest, a tan barrel with grey bars and a ladder, a pink collar, a steel neck), the eye in a black socket, a red armoured pod under it and a grey and tan stinger at the bottom; two big tan wings with red and grey wingtip blocks, thin cables up to grey pylons behind the tower; a tan chevron plate across the body down to grey shoulder blocks with framed red windows; a brown claw and a thin grey hook hanging from each shoulder. Shape language: hard, chamfered bronze and steel armour plates stacked in layers, with round parts only where the sprite draws them (dome, barrel, stinger, claws, cables).

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: glowing eye in a black socket at col 60, rows 48-53, yellow-white core in red-orange glow
emissive, set in the socket, animated shutter frames kept
features.note: The boss's focal point (concept: a glowing red orb).

traits: grey steel dome at the top (rows 5-13) with a tan brim and a light tan crest up its middle
tan barrel below (rows 19-38) as wide as the brim, round, about 10-11 px tall
two light grey bars down its sides and a ladder down its middle, pink light under the brim
pink collar and steel neck at its front
features.note: Baseline: dome, brim, band, barrel, collar, neck. Concept: a stacked drum with a cap.

traits: two red armour cheeks either side of a dark slot down the middle (cols 58-62), the slot cut in
each cheek: a tall inner ridge (cols 55-57 / 63-65, about 11 px high) and a lower outer block out to col 50 / 70
a dark tan vent cut into each outer block (cols 52-54 / 66-68, rows 58-64) in a red frame
hard, chamfered plates, not a smooth barrel; black lower pod under them
features.note: Baseline: a ribbed red barrel. Concept: two red armour plates with vent grilles round a central slot.

traits: dome about 23 px wide and 12-13 px tall standing on the plane, polished grey upper half, tan lower band
